title: Shrink directive compiler to a gap projection
description: WHY: with gaps as input and a gap-keyed registry, the 1369-line compiler (packages/core/src/agent-directive-compiler.ts) reduces to look up each gap code, fill the typed data slots from the gap payload, dedupe, and order by severity. Conflict machinery exists to arbitrate overlapping appliesTo matches; once matching is gone, conflicts can only arise from duplicate registry keys, which the registry tests from the previous task already forbid. WHAT: rewrite bundle assembly as that projection, keep the AgentDirectiveBundle output schema stable for consumers (schemas/directives/agent-directive-bundle.schema.json) or version it deliberately, and delete the snapshot assembler paths that existed only to feed the matcher (packages/core/src/agent-directive-snapshot.ts lines dealing with commandPath and workStatus fan-out) - the command envelope now passes its gaps directly. Update apps/cli formatRecordWithAgentDirectives and the debug fixtures (apps/cli/src/commands.ts around lines 1990-2080) to build from gap fixtures instead of synthetic snapshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Bundle assembly is a pure function from gaps plus registry to bundle, unit tested with gap fixtures
AgentDirectiveBundle schema consumers (CLI, console, MCP, ui-model) pass their existing tests or have deliberate versioned updates
Compiler and snapshot module line counts drop and the removed conflict paths are covered by a registry-duplicate-key test instead
closedReason: Gap-projection directive compiler and CLI projection path implemented and verified
